# Overview

This report compares the performance and accuracy of two functions for computing 
bivariate Moran's I across multiple kernel bandwidth scales:

1. **`soupir_moran_multi()`** - Legacy R implementation
2. **`multiScaleAC()`** - New implementation with RcppEigen backend

We benchmark both functions using the included `ccRCCExample` dataset, comparing:
- Execution time
- Memory allocation
- Accuracy of observed Moran's I values

# Environment Setup

## Install and Load Required Packages

```{r install-packages, eval=TRUE}
required_packages <- c("devtools", "bench", "rmarkdown", "knitr", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr")

for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    message(paste("Installing", pkg, "..."))
    install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(pkg, character.only = TRUE))
}

message("All required packages loaded successfully.")
```

## Load KernelCommunication Package

```{r load-package, eval=TRUE}
library(devtools)
load_all()
message("KernelCommunication package loaded successfully.")
```

## Load Example Dataset

```{r load-data, eval=TRUE}
data(ccRCCExample, package = "KernelCommunication")

cat("Full dataset dimensions:", nrow(ccRCCExample), "cells\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(names(ccRCCExample), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Optionally use subset for faster benchmarking
use_subset <- params$use_subset
subset_size <- params$subset_size

if (use_subset && nrow(ccRCCExample) > subset_size) {
  set.seed(42)
  idx <- sample(1:nrow(ccRCCExample), subset_size)
  cat("Using subset of", subset_size, "cells for benchmarking\n")
} else {
  idx <- 1:nrow(ccRCCExample)
  cat("Using full dataset\n")
}

coords <- as.matrix(ccRCCExample[idx, c("x", "y")])
gene1 <- ccRCCExample$CD274[idx]
gene2 <- ccRCCExample$PDCD1[idx]

cat("Coordinates range: x [", min(coords[,1]), ",", max(coords[,1]), "], ",
    "y [", min(coords[,2]), ",", max(coords[,2]), "]\n")
```

# Benchmark Configuration

```{r config, eval=TRUE}
h_max <- params$h_max
h_by <- params$h_by
perms <- params$perms
seed <- params$seed
bench_iterations <- params$bench_iterations

h_vec <- seq(h_by, h_max, by = h_by)

cat("Bandwidth range:", min(h_vec), "to", max(h_vec), "\n")
cat("Number of bandwidths:", length(h_vec), "\n")
cat("Number of permutations:", perms, "\n")
cat("Random seed:", seed, "\n")
cat("Benchmark iterations:", bench_iterations, "\n")
```

# Benchmark Execution

## Running soupir_moran_multi()

```{r benchmark-soupir, eval=TRUE}
soupir_result <- NULL
soupir_bench <- NULL

tryCatch({
  soupir_bench <- bench::mark(
    soupir_moran_multi(
      coords = coords,
      gene1 = gene1,
      gene2 = gene2,
      h_vec = h_vec,
      perms = perms,
      seed = seed
    ),
    iterations = bench_iterations,
    check = FALSE,
    filter_gc = TRUE
  )
  
  soupir_result <- soupir_moran_multi(
    coords = coords,
    gene1 = gene1,
    gene2 = gene2,
    h_vec = h_vec,
    perms = perms,
    seed = seed
  )
  
  cat("soupir_moran_multi() completed successfully.\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Error in soupir_moran_multi():", e$message, "\n")
})

if (!is.null(soupir_bench)) {
  print(soupir_bench)
}
```

## Running multiScaleAC()

```{r benchmark-multiscale, eval=TRUE}
multiscale_result <- NULL
multiscale_bench <- NULL

tryCatch({
  multiscale_bench <- bench::mark(
    multiScaleAC(
      coords = coords,
      gene1 = gene1,
      gene2 = gene2,
      h = h_vec,
      perms = perms,
      seed = seed,
      kernel = "gaussian",
      dist_method = "euclidean"
    ),
    iterations = bench_iterations,
    check = FALSE,
    filter_gc = TRUE
  )
  
  multiscale_result <- multiScaleAC(
    coords = coords,
    gene1 = gene1,
    gene2 = gene2,
    h = h_vec,
    perms = perms,
    seed = seed,
    kernel = "gaussian",
    dist_method = "euclidean"
  )
  
  cat("multiScaleAC() completed successfully.\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Error in multiScaleAC():", e$message, "\n")
})

if (!is.null(multiscale_bench)) {
  print(multiscale_bench)
}
```

# Results

## Timing Comparison

```{r timing-summary, eval=TRUE}
soupir_valid <- !is.null(soupir_bench) && nrow(soupir_bench) > 0
multiscale_valid <- !is.null(multiscale_bench) && nrow(multiscale_bench) > 0

if (soupir_valid && multiscale_valid) {
  soupir_median <- as.numeric(soupir_bench$median)
  multiscale_median <- as.numeric(multiscale_bench$median)
  soupir_mean <- mean(as.numeric(soupir_bench$time[[1]]))
  multiscale_mean <- mean(as.numeric(multiscale_bench$time[[1]]))
  soupir_mem <- as.numeric(soupir_bench$mem_alloc)
  multiscale_mem <- as.numeric(multiscale_bench$mem_alloc)
  
  timing_df <- data.frame(
    Function = c("soupir_moran_multi()", "multiScaleAC()"),
    Median_Time = c(soupir_median, multiscale_median),
    Mean_Time = c(soupir_mean, multiscale_mean),
    Memory_MB = c(soupir_mem, multiscale_mem) / (1024^2)
  )
  
  knitr::kable(timing_df, 
               caption = "Performance Summary",
               digits = 3,
               col.names = c("Function", "Median Time (s)", "Mean Time (s)", "Memory (MB)"))
  
  speed_ratio <- soupir_median / multiscale_median
  cat("\nSpeed ratio (soupir/multiScaleAC):", round(speed_ratio, 2), "x\n")
} else {
  cat("Benchmark results not available.\n")
  cat("soupir_bench valid:", soupir_valid, "\n")
  cat("multiscale_bench valid:", multiscale_valid, "\n")
}
```

## Timing Visualization

```{r timing-plot, eval=TRUE, fig.cap="Execution time comparison between soupir_moran_multi() and multiScaleAC()"}
soupir_valid <- !is.null(soupir_bench) && nrow(soupir_bench) > 0
multiscale_valid <- !is.null(multiscale_bench) && nrow(multiscale_bench) > 0

if (soupir_valid && multiscale_valid) {
  soupir_times <- as.numeric(soupir_bench$time[[1]])
  multiscale_times <- as.numeric(multiscale_bench$time[[1]])
  n_iter <- max(length(soupir_times), length(multiscale_times))
  
  timing_plot_data <- data.frame(
    Function = rep(c("soupir_moran_multi()", "multiScaleAC()"), each = n_iter),
    Time = c(soupir_times[1:n_iter], multiscale_times[1:n_iter]),
    Iteration = rep(1:n_iter, 2)
  )
  
  ggplot(timing_plot_data, aes(x = Function, y = Time, fill = Function)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Execution Time Comparison",
      x = "Function",
      y = "Time (seconds)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    ) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
} else {
  cat("Benchmark results not available for plotting.\n")
}
```

# Accuracy Comparison

## Observed Moran's I Values

```{r accuracy-data, eval=TRUE}
if (!is.null(soupir_result) && !is.null(multiscale_result)) {
  accuracy_df <- data.frame(
    h = h_vec,
    soupir = soupir_result$observed,
    multiScaleAC = multiscale_result$observed
  )
  
  accuracy_df$absolute_diff <- abs(accuracy_df$soupir - accuracy_df$multiScaleAC)
  accuracy_df$relative_diff <- abs((accuracy_df$soupir - accuracy_df$multiScaleAC) / 
                                     accuracy_df$soupir)
  accuracy_df$relative_diff[is.infinite(accuracy_df$relative_diff)] <- NA
  
  cat("Summary of observed Moran's I values:\n")
  print(summary(accuracy_df$absolute_diff))
  cat("\nMaximum absolute difference:", max(accuracy_df$absolute_diff, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Mean absolute error (MAE):", mean(accuracy_df$absolute_diff, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Root mean square error (RMSE):", 
      sqrt(mean(accuracy_df$absolute_diff^2, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
  cat("Correlation between methods:", 
      cor(accuracy_df$soupir, accuracy_df$multiScaleAC, use = "complete.obs"), "\n")
}
```

## Observed Moran's I Comparison Plot

```{r observed-plot, eval=TRUE, fig.cap="Comparison of observed Moran's I values across bandwidths"}
if (!is.null(soupir_result) && !is.null(multiscale_result)) {
  plot_df <- data.frame(
    h = rep(h_vec, 2),
    Moran_I = c(soupir_result$observed, multiscale_result$observed),
    Function = rep(c("soupir_moran_multi()", "multiScaleAC()"), each = length(h_vec))
  )
  
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = h, y = Moran_I, color = Function, linetype = Function)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    labs(
      title = "Observed Moran's I vs Bandwidth",
      x = "Bandwidth (h)",
      y = "Moran's I"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    ) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")
}
```

## Difference Plot

```{r difference-plot, eval=TRUE, fig.cap="Absolute difference in observed Moran's I between methods"}
if (!is.null(soupir_result) && !is.null(multiscale_result)) {
  diff_df <- data.frame(
    h = h_vec,
    absolute_diff = abs(soupir_result$observed - multiscale_result$observed)
  )
  
  ggplot(diff_df, aes(x = h, y = absolute_diff)) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1e-10, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1e-14, linetype = "dotted", color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title = "Absolute Difference: soupir_moran_multi() - multiScaleAC()",
      x = "Bandwidth (h)",
      y = "Absolute Difference"
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = max(h_vec) * 0.7, y = 1e-10 * 1.1, 
             label = "1e-10 threshold", color = "red", hjust = 0) +
    annotate("text", x = max(h_vec) * 0.7, y = 1e-14 * 1.1, 
             label = "Machine epsilon (~1e-14)", color = "darkgreen", hjust = 0) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    ) +
    scale_y_log10()
}
```

## Accuracy Summary Table

```{r accuracy-table, eval=TRUE}
if (!is.null(soupir_result) && !is.null(multiscale_result)) {
  accuracy_summary <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Maximum Absolute Difference",
      "Mean Absolute Error (MAE)",
      "Root Mean Square Error (RMSE)",
      "Correlation Coefficient",
      "Values within 1e-10 tolerance",
      "Values within 1e-14 tolerance"
    ),
    Value = c(
      max(accuracy_df$absolute_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean(accuracy_df$absolute_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
      sqrt(mean(accuracy_df$absolute_diff^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      cor(accuracy_df$soupir, accuracy_df$multiScaleAC, use = "complete.obs"),
      paste0(sum(accuracy_df$absolute_diff < 1e-10), " / ", length(h_vec)),
      paste0(sum(accuracy_df$absolute_diff < 1e-14), " / ", length(h_vec))
    )
  )
  
  knitr::kable(accuracy_summary,
               caption = "Accuracy Comparison Summary",
               col.names = c("Metric", "Value"))
}
```

# Conclusions

```{r conclusions, eval=TRUE}
if (!is.null(soupir_bench) && !is.null(multiscale_bench) && 
    !is.null(soupir_result) && !is.null(multiscale_result)) {
  
  speed_ratio <- median(soupir_bench$elapsed) / median(multiscale_bench$elapsed)
  memory_ratio <- median(soupir_bench$mem_alloc) / median(multiscale_bench$mem_alloc)
  max_diff <- max(accuracy_df$absolute_diff, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat("## Summary\n\n")
  cat("### Performance\n")
  cat(sprintf("- **Speed**: multiScaleAC() is %.2fx %s than soupir_moran_multi()\n",
              ifelse(speed_ratio > 1, speed_ratio, 1/speed_ratio),
              ifelse(speed_ratio > 1, "faster", "slower")))
  cat(sprintf("- **Memory**: multiScaleAC() uses %.2fx %s memory than soupir_moran_multi()\n",
              ifelse(memory_ratio > 1, 1/memory_ratio, memory_ratio),
              ifelse(memory_ratio > 1, "less", "more")))
  
  cat("\n### Accuracy\n")
  cat(sprintf("- **Maximum absolute difference**: %.2e\n", max_diff))
  cat(sprintf("- **Correlation**: %.6f\n", 
              cor(accuracy_df$soupir, accuracy_df$multiScaleAC, use = "complete.obs")))
  
  if (max_diff < 1e-14) {
    cat("- **Assessment**: Functions produce identical results within machine precision\n")
  } else if (max_diff < 1e-10) {
    cat("- **Assessment**: Functions produce nearly identical results (difference < 1e-10)\n")
  } else {
    cat("- **Assessment**: Functions show small but notable differences\n")
  }
}
```
